phase3_findings.description: constants comment claimed the AC12 divergence test guards all engine_self_modifying arms, but the test pinned only arm 1
_is_engine_own_repo returns False on unresolvable identity, excluding the engine arm
confirmed-write stderr asserted non-engine-source verified even on consumer repos where the arm was not evaluated
missing ceiling boundary tests, override-ignored path, engine arms 2/3 write-path coverage, empty-diff case
AC3 design: all three engine arms scoped by repo-identity; reviewer confirmed faithful to AC3 as written

fix_decisions.evidence: extended the AC12 divergence test to parse and pin engine-source arm 2 (state dirs .prflow/.devflow) and arm 3 (CLAUDE.md) against phase-0-setup.md, satisfying AC12's plural 'engine-source path arms'; the constants comment is now accurate

the suggested fix (route identity-unresolution to unestablished) would VIOLATE AC3's 'On any other repository the same lib/** change is confirmed' — every consumer's legitimate skipped-intentional (repo != engine, so plugin.json name != prflow or absent) would become unestablished. AC3 mandates applying the engine arm 'only when the checkout is this repository itself', so returning False when identity cannot be positively established is AC3-faithful. The residual (plugin.json unreadable in the engine's OWN checkout) is a broken-checkout state where the git recompute itself would also fail; graded low reachability by the reviewer.

parking_evidence.basis: the proposed fail-closed-to-unestablished direction conflicts with AC3's consumer-confirm requirement
parking_evidence.failing_input: a consumer repo (name != prflow or no plugin.json) recording a legitimate skipped-intentional
parking_evidence.source: AC3 + the test '#1509 AC3: the same lib/** change on another repository is confirmed'

fix_decisions.evidence: the confirmed-write stderr breadcrumb now names the engine-source arm as verified only in this engine's own repo; on any other repo it states the arm was not evaluated (2.3.6 all-output-channels honesty)

added ceiling-boundary tests (99 confirm / 100 refuse; 3 files confirm / 4 refuse), engine arms 2 and 3 write-path refusal (plus arm-3 consumer-confirm), an empty-diff confirm, and the override-ignored-on-non-skipped-intentional stderr path

AC3 interpretation confirmed faithful by the reviewer consensus; the consumer-side arms-2/3 backstop is intentionally the Phase 0.5 classifier's job, and the workpad gate is a redundant backstop there per AC3
